status: prepared; frozen by the commit root reviews before any grant. No build, GPU child or capture has run for this stage.

fields.source_commit: 40-hex commit whose build inputs equal the producer's (build.py checkout refuses otherwise)
fields.visual_tree: git rev-parse <commit>:handoffs/0073-upscaling-review/visual of the reviewed commit
fields.target: a dedicated ~/.codex/<name>-target directory chosen by root
fields.prior_<name>_path / prior_<name>_sha256: at least one prior release receipt, e.g. 0073-upscaling-numeric/gpu-released.json

builds.note: Default features only. Every cooked-* family refuses motion history (motion::admission), so a cooked feature in the build fails the stage before any GPU child.

policy.note: Fixed review policy, identical to the 0072 fixed-resolution review; there is no quality preset.

probe.purpose: Adapter and backend; the owner refuses before the startup opt-in; opt-in succeeds and is idempotent; the review policy validates and five invalid policies are refused by validation and by the owner; logical owner footprint recorded as context only.

stationary.purpose: Static look-dev stage. FULL output-size control and DRS 8/16 nearest control (each with the physical UI), then 24 UP 8/16 frames: three 8-phase jitter cycles, UI on the last 8. Thin detail (1.6, 0.8 and 0.4 px wires and a 0.56 px diagonal against the backdrop; posts receding to about 1.3 px), a trilinear-mipmapped chart at about one texel per output pixel, sphere and cube silhouettes, sun shadows, a BLEND card, nearest-sampled sprites and world text.

motion.purpose: The stage plus a cube: 8 static UP frames, then the cube moves 0.12 m (about 8 px) per frame out from behind the sphere across the chart (occlusion and disocclusion), and from frame 15 the camera also pans 0.05 m per frame. FULL and DRS controls render frames 14 and 20 exactly.

transitions.purpose: The stage in a fractional, offset, rounded viewport. FULL and DRS 8/16 controls, then UP: 10 frames at 8/16, internal-only changes to 12, 4, 16 and 8 sixteenths (3 frames each, one owner and history throughout), then an explicit cut and 5 frames at 8/16.

counting: A frame is one queue submission that renders into a 960x540 review target: every RetainedScene::submit attempt, including refusals and failures, and every UiLayer::submit. Readback copies are part of their frame. The helper charges each frame before attempting it and panics past its case limit; gpu.py debits each case's full reserve under the packet and shared GPU locks, fsyncs it and only then launches. Debits are never refunded, and a failed case ends the stage.
contract_checks_only: Pass/fail comes from submitted-owner state (phase, history, epoch, sequence, internal and output size), control identity, opaque UI interior identity, viewport chrome identity and non-blank frames. Image metrics are observations; appearance is judged only by inspecting the PNGs.
order: analyze.py check (CPU only) and personal inspection of every retained PNG
build.py lint (optional, CPU only, still under the lease)
